strategy.thesis: A cross-Pacific angel network ('angel accelerator') founded by IC Chan and Bryan Huang that connects Taiwan's angel investors and industry resources with Silicon Valley / Bay Area startups, focusing on early-stage deep tech, industrial automation, medtech and AI that can leverage Taiwan's manufacturing, healthcare and channel strengths.

summary.en: Taiwan Global Angels (TGA) is a Berkeley- and Taipei-based cross-Pacific angel network founded in early 2022 by IC Chan (詹益鑑) and lawyer Bryan Huang (黃沛聲). Positioned as an 'angel accelerator', it channels Taiwanese angel capital and industry know-how into early-stage Silicon Valley startups in deep tech, medtech, robotics and AI. Typical checks are US$300K-500K (Pre-A/Series A) and cumulative investment has exceeded NT$600M.
summary.local: Taiwan Global Angels（TGA）是 2022 年初由詹益鑑（IC）與律師黃沛聲共同創立、橫跨台灣與矽谷的天使投資網絡，總部設於美國柏克萊與台北。定位為「天使加速器」，將台灣天使資金與產業資源導入矽谷早期深科技、醫療科技、機器人與 AI 新創。Pre-A／A 輪單筆約 30–50 萬美元，累計投資金額已逾新台幣 6 億元。

name.local: 國科會南台灣科技新創基地

offices.city: Tainan (Shalun Smart Green Energy Science City, Guiren District)

strategy.thesis: The southern hub of the National Science and Technology Council's flagship Taiwan Tech Arena program, located in Tainan's Shalun Smart Green Energy Science City, focused on three verticals — Smart Tech, Precision Medicine, and Clean & Circular Tech — and offering Taiwan's most comprehensive tech verification/demonstration sites for deep-tech startups outside the Taipei hub.

program.location: Tainan (Shalun Smart Green Energy Science City, C Zone, Cybersecurity & Smart Technology R&D Building)
program.eligibility: Tech startups in smart tech, precision medicine, clean & circular tech

summary.en: TTA South (國科會南台灣科技新創基地) is the Tainan-based southern hub of the National Science and Technology Council's flagship Taiwan Tech Arena (TTA, est. 2018) program. Opened in late 2021 in the Shalun Smart Green Energy Science City with a 4,290 sqm co-creation space, it admitted a first cohort of 28 startups and focuses on Smart Tech, Precision Medicine and Clean & Circular Tech — bringing TTA's international-grade acceleration outside the Taipei hub.
summary.local: TTA South（國科會南台灣科技新創基地）是國家科學及技術委員會旗艦計畫 Taiwan Tech Arena（TTA，2018 年成立）設於台南的南部據點。2021 年底於沙崙智慧綠能科學園區啟用，擁有約 4,290 平方公尺共創空間，首波進駐 28 家新創，聚焦智慧科技、精準醫療與淨零循環科技，將 TTA 的國際級加速能量延伸至台北以外的南台灣。

name.local: 亞灣新創園 / 創業台灣高雄基地

offices.city: Kaohsiung (Qianzhen District, Asia New Bay Area)

strategy.thesis: The Kaohsiung (Asia New Bay Area) hub of the MOEA's Taiwan Startup Terrace, providing subsidised offices, proof-of-concept space, accelerator consulting and international matchmaking for AIoT, 5G, motion-sensing, maritime-tech and smart-manufacturing startups in southern Taiwan — a non-Taipei base for emerging founders and foreign accelerators.

perks: international resource connection, accelerator consulting, business matchmaking
program.eligibility: Startups in AIoT, 5G, motion sensing, maritime tech, smart manufacturing; also local/foreign accelerators

summary.en: The Taiwan Startup Terrace Kaohsiung Hub is the southern (Asia New Bay Area) base of the Ministry of Economic Affairs' Taiwan Startup Terrace program, run by the SME & Startup Administration with the Taipei Computer Association. Located in Qianzhen District, Kaohsiung, it offers subsidised offices (NT$24,200-66,000/month), co-working seats (NT$3,600/month), PoC space and accelerator/matchmaking services for AIoT, 5G, maritime-tech and smart-manufacturing startups — a non-Taipei landing pad for emerging founders.
summary.local: 創業台灣高雄基地（亞灣新創園）是經濟部「Taiwan Startup Terrace 林口新創園」計畫的南部據點，由中小及新創企業署委由台北市電腦公會營運，位於高雄市前鎮區亞洲新灣區。提供補貼辦公室（每月 24,200–66,000 元）、共享座位（每月 3,600 元）、概念驗證空間與加速器顧問、商業媒合等服務，鎖定 AIoT、5G、體感、海洋科技與智慧製造新創，是台北以外的早期創業據點。

strategy.thesis: A themed AIoT acceleration program co-created since 2022 by StarFab Accelerator and the Hsinchu County Government for the greater Hsinchu area, matching AIoT / generative-AI / cloud startups with regional corporate partners (Accton, King Ray Optronics, Systex, Wiadvance, etc.) through field validation and a year-end Demo Day.

program.eligibility: AIoT / AI / generative AI / cloud startups, greater Hsinchu focus

summary.en: The Hsinchu AIoT Accelerator (新竹AIoT加速器) is a themed acceleration program co-created since 2022 by StarFab Accelerator (Taiwan's largest corporate-startup accelerator, est. 2016) and the Hsinchu County Government for the greater Hsinchu area. Run under the 'Youth Entrepreneurship — Turning Dreams into Reality' program, it offers ~4 months of co-creation mentoring, field-validation subsidies for ~5 potential teams, corporate matchmaking and a year-end Demo Day, focusing on AIoT, generative AI and cloud — a non-Taipei accelerator in Taiwan's semiconductor heartland.
summary.local: 新竹AIoT加速器是 StarFab 加速器（全台最大產業加速器，2016 年成立）自 2022 年起與新竹縣政府共同為大新竹地區打造的 AIoT 主題定向加速器。隸屬「青年創業—築夢踏實」計畫，提供約 4 個月共創輔導、為約 5 組潛力團隊提供場域驗證補助、企業媒合及年末成果博覽會（Demo Day），聚焦 AIoT、生成式 AI 與雲端，是位於台灣半導體核心區、台北以外的加速器。

funds.name: FSP-MVL Innovation & Sustainability Fund (FSP Mosaic Innovation Sustainability L.P.)

strategy.thesis: A mobility-focused venture lab / company builder bridging global automotive leaders (VW Group, Audi, Continental) with East Asia's advanced-manufacturing ecosystems, investing in EVs, smart connectivity and autonomous driving; raising the US$100M Movtec Mobility Fund I and a 2025 FSP-MVL Innovation & Sustainability seed fund with power-supply maker FSP Group.

summary.en: Mosaic Venture Lab (MVL) is a Taipei-based, mobility-focused venture lab / company builder operating from Taiwan Tech Arena, co-founded around 2018 by Volker Heistermann, Ken Huang and Johnny Yu. It bridges global automakers (VW Group, Audi, Continental) with East-Asian manufacturing and is raising new vehicles — the announced US$100M Movtec Mobility Fund I and, in 2025, a seed-stage FSP-MVL Innovation & Sustainability Fund jointly with TWSE-listed power maker FSP Group (3015) targeting semiconductors, mobility and AI.
summary.local: Mosaic Venture Lab（MVL）是位於台北、進駐 Taiwan Tech Arena 的智慧移動創業工作室，約 2018 年由 Volker Heistermann、Ken Huang 與 Johnny Yu 共同創立，串接全球車廠（福斯集團、奧迪、Continental）與東亞先進製造。近年募集新基金——對外宣布的 1 億美元 Movtec Mobility Fund I，以及 2025 年與上市電源廠全漢（FSP，3015）合資、聚焦半導體／移動／AI 的種子期 FSP-MVL 創新永續基金。

funds.name: 生鵬一號基金 (Sheng Peng Fund No.1)

strategy.thesis: A NT$2 billion biotech venture fund established by Taiwan's government-affiliated Development Center for Biotechnology (DCB), backed by domestic private capital, the National Development Fund and Japanese/Singaporean investors, to invest in medical devices and new-drug startups and pull DCB-incubated 'Venture Studio' teams into international markets.

summary.en: Sheng Peng Fund No.1 (生鵬一號基金) is a NT$2 billion biotech venture fund set up by Taiwan's government-affiliated Development Center for Biotechnology (DCB). Announced in 2021 and targeted to launch in 2022, it was a landmark vehicle that broke a 20-year rule limiting government-founded foundations from investing, drawing on domestic private capital, the National Development Fund and Japanese/Singaporean LPs to fund medical-device and new-drug startups alongside DCB's incubation 'Venture Studio'.
summary.local: 生鵬一號基金是由我國財團法人生物技術開發中心（DCB）設立、規模約新台幣 20 億元的生技創投基金。2021 年宣布、規劃 2022 年成立，是突破財團法人逾 20 年投資限制的指標性基金，資金來自國內民間、國發基金及日本、新加坡投資人，投資醫材與新藥新創，並與 DCB 的育成「Venture Studio」平台串接，協助團隊進軍國際市場。

strategy.thesis: A NT$1 billion cultural-technology venture fund managed by Mannitok Management Consulting (曼尼托克管顧), established with Taiwan Business Bank, to back the digital film & TV IP industry, cultural-artistic technology and digital cultural-media platforms.

summary.en: Manny Fund No.1 (曼尼一號) is a NT$1 billion cultural-technology venture fund announced in March 2022, managed by Mannitok Management Consulting (曼尼托克管顧) and established together with Taiwan Business Bank (台企銀). It targets the digital film & TV IP industry, cultural-artistic technology and digital cultural-media platforms — one of the emerging Taiwan creative-economy funds launched in the 2022 wave.
summary.local: 曼尼一號是 2022 年 3 月宣布、規模約新台幣 10 億元的文化科技創投基金，由曼尼托克管理顧問公司管理、並與台灣企銀（台企銀）共同設立，鎖定數位影視 IP 產業、文化藝術科技與數位文化媒體平台，是 2022 年一波台灣文創／新興基金之一。
